**tuna-fonts 0.4.0**: get to know your fonts. Filter by OpenType features, see who made a font and what it covers, and take your library anywhere. If you have 0.3.x or older, the app will offer it when you open it.

### New
- **A typographic tuna as the new icon**: a wide α from Noto Serif that is also a fish, as someone on Reddit suggested. Made to read well in the taskbar too.
- **Filter by OpenType features.** A new group in the sidebar lists what your fonts can do: small caps, oldstyle figures, tabular figures, ligatures, swashes, stylistic sets and fractions. Click one to see only the fonts that have it, and combine it with a category. Thanks to the Reddit user who asked for true small caps and oldstyle figures!
- **Right-click menu** on any font: open its page, activate, deactivate, favorite, change category, show in File Explorer or uninstall. If the font is part of a selection, it acts on the whole selection.
- **A richer font page**: designer, foundry, version, website, license and copyright straight from the file, the name it shows up as in your apps, which **scripts** it covers (Latin, Greek, Cyrillic, Arabic, CJK…), and its **OpenType features** with live examples.
- **Duplicate styles** are flagged: if the same style is in more than one file, the list marks the family and its page shows the files, so you can clean them up.
- **Install from a .zip**: drop it on the window and the fonts inside are installed, subfolders included.
- **Export and import your library.** Settings → *Copy of your library*: favorites and collections in one file, to take them to another PC or keep a backup. You can also export a single collection to share it. Importing never deletes anything; collections with the same name are merged.

### Improved
- **Switching theme fades smoothly** instead of snapping, and the selectors no longer flash black or white.
- **A cleaner size slider**, like the one in the Finder: a thin track and a white handle. Click the small or big A to go down or up, and double-click the track to go back to 30.

The first time you open 0.4.0, it reads your fonts again to find their features, so the list may take a little longer to appear once.

### Downloads
- **`tuna-fonts_0.4.0_x64-setup.exe`**: installer (per user, no admin rights needed). Updates itself.
- **`tuna-fonts_0.4.0_x64-portable.zip`**: portable version; unzip and run `tuna-fonts.exe`.

Windows 10/11, 64-bit. **Not code-signed**, so Windows SmartScreen may warn you the first time: *More info → Run anyway*.

Found a bug? [Open an issue](https://github.com/atunfrito/tuna-fonts/issues/new/choose).

---

**En español:** la 0.4.0 te deja conocer mejor tus fuentes. Puedes filtrar por funciones OpenType (versalitas, números antiguos y tabulares, ligaduras, florituras, conjuntos estilísticos y fracciones), combinables con las categorías. Hay menú con clic derecho en cualquier fuente (ficha, activar, desactivar, favorita, categoría, Explorador, desinstalar), que actúa sobre toda la selección si la fuente está en ella. La ficha dice quién la diseñó, el fabricante, la versión, la web, la licencia y el copyright, con qué nombre sale en tus programas, qué alfabetos cubre y qué funciones OpenType trae, con ejemplos. Avisa de estilos duplicados en varios archivos. Se instala arrastrando un .zip. En Ajustes → *Copia de tu biblioteca* exportas e importas favoritas y colecciones, y una colección suelta se exporta desde su propia página. Estrena icono: un atún tipográfico, una α ancha de Noto Serif que es también un pez. Además, el cambio de tema es un fundido suave y la barra de tamaño es nueva. La primera vez que la abras volverá a leer tus fuentes, así que puede tardar un poco más en salir la lista.
